fichas.title: Client and Architect Responsibilities
fichas.summary: The client or commissioner is the decision-maker on a building’s characteristics and bears substantial responsibility for its quality and sustainability. The architect acts as consulting expert, coordinating specialists and balancing design expertise with service-provider duties such as transparency and reliable cost and schedule estimates.

fichas.title: Clients, Producers, and Building Delivery
fichas.summary: Owner-occupiers generally seek an appropriate balance between function, company image, and cost, while investors seek successful letting or sale under current market conditions. The page contrasts contemporary professional client and trade structures with earlier building-delivery arrangements, and notes that differing client demands shape development, design, and construction processes.
uses: Develop and deliver buildings for owner-occupiers or investors
Align development, design, and construction with client objectives

fichas.title: Complex Requirements for Buildings
fichas.summary: Building value is described through a combination of quantitative and qualitative parameters: achievable rents, comprehensible whole-life costs, practical conversion possibilities based on long-term use scenarios, and disturbance-free operation.
uses: Assess building value and property-management requirements
Plan for conversion and long-term operation

fichas.title: Life-Cycle Assessment of a Building
fichas.summary: Architectural design should consider all phases of a building’s lifetime and systematically account for functional, aesthetic, cost, scheduling, and organisational aspects. Experience from operation should inform later projects; the resulting approach treats the planned building as a maintainable asset that may remain useful beyond its original purpose. The diagram distinguishes concept, design, building, and operation phases and contrasts cumulative costs with the influence on costs.
uses: Assess building requirements across the life cycle
Transfer operational experience to future projects

fichas.title: Project Development and Programme Production
fichas.summary: The initial work phase develops room and function programmes for an owner-operator or tenant scenarios for an investor. Careful programming can increase project value by improving working and communication processes and reducing the space needed through appropriate compression of use.
uses: Develop tenant scenarios for investor clients
